record.paper_title: Problem collection from the IML programme: Graphs, Hypergraphs, and Computing
record.original_question: Let a(n) be the maximum size of the automorphism group of a 3-connected cubic graph with n vertices. Is it true that a(n)<n·2^{n/4} for every n≥16?

evidence.quote: Let a(n) be the greatest order of the automorphism group of a 3-connected cubic graph with n vertices. I conjecture: for n ≥ 16, a(n) < n 2 n/4.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For an integer $n\ge 4$, let $a(n)$ denote the maximum, over all 3-connected cubic (i.e. 3-regular) simple graphs $G$ on $n$ vertices, of the order $|\mathrm{Aut}(G)|$ of the automorphism group of $G$. Prove or disprove the following inequality: for every integer $n\ge 16$,
$$a(n) < n\cdot 2^{n/4}.$$
artifact.status_search_result: A sharp bound on the automorphism group of arbitrary connected cubic simple graphs was given by van Opstall and Veliche (2010), but no source located in the search specifically resolves the conjectured bound $a(n)<n\cdot 2^{n/4}$ for 3-connected cubic graphs with $n\ge 16$. The current status of this specific conjecture could not be verified from the available search results.

status_evidence.title: Cubic graphs with most automorphisms - van Opstall, Veliche
status_evidence.snippet: We give a sharp bound for the automorphism group of a cubic simple graph with a given number of vertices.
status_evidence.claim: A sharp bound is known for connected cubic simple graphs, but the cited result does not directly address the 3-connected case with the specific bound n*2^{n/4}.

status_evidence.title: Cubic graphs with most automorphisms - van Opstall - 2010 - Journal of Graph Theory
status_evidence.snippet: Sharp bound for automorphism group of a cubic simple graph.
status_evidence.claim: Related work on cubic graph automorphism bounds; does not confirm resolution of the 3-connected conjecture.
